paragraphs.text: He shows how the Church will praise God, when they are delivered from their captivity.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: Our salvation stands only in God, who gives us an assured confidence, constancy and opportunity to praise him for the same.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: The graces of God will be so abundant that you may receive them in as great plenty as waters out of a fountain that is full.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: draw water out of the wells

paragraphs.text: You who are of the Church.
paragraphs.label: d
